newsitem.title: ISRAEL: RESEARCH ALERT: Elron is strong buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT: Elron is strong buy.

text.p: Salomon Brothers said on Monday that it was retaining its strong buy recommendation for Israel's Elron Electronic Industries Ltd.

Analyst Victor Halpert said based on an analytical valuation, which takes into account future earnings value, Elron was trading at a 32 percent discount to net asset value (NAV). Based on book valuation, the share was trading at a 9.88 percent premium.
"Elron's NAV should continue to rise in 1997-98 as its main holding, the Elbit group, improves its performance and accelerates shareholders' value," Halpert said.
In November Elbit was broken up into three publicly traded companies -- Elbit Systems Ltd, Elbit Medical Imaging Ltd and Elbit Ltd.
"The purpose of Elbit's demerger was to allow greater business focus and improve revenue and earnings growth, which in total is expected to increase shareholders' value," Halpert said.
